title: Spectral Design of Random-Duration Switchbacks
abstract: arXiv:2609.13698v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A switchback experiment alternates an entire system between treatment and control over time. It is especially useful when interactions between units can undermine standard unit-level experiments. Switchback experiments are commonly implemented on fixed temporal grids, which impose highly structured restrictions on when treatment can switch. We study a broader class of random-duration switchbacks, in which treatment and control alternate across runs whose durations are drawn from a common distribution. Under finite carryover, we show that the mean squared error of the Horvitz-Thompson estimator has a simple frequency-domain representation governed by how temporal outcome patterns align with design-induced imbalance and contamination patterns. This representation yields a tractable worst-case design criterion that can be computed directly from the duration distribution. Optimizing over even a simple two-rate family produces a run-age-dep

translated_title: 随机时长切换实验的频谱设计
translated_abstract: 切换实验使整个系统随时间在处理组与对照组之间交替进行。当单元之间的相互作用可能破坏标准的单元级实验时，这种方法尤其有用。切换实验通常在固定的时间网格上实施，这对处理状态切换的时机施加了高度结构化的限制。我们研究了更广泛的一类随机时长切换实验，其中处理与控制在多个运行片段之间交替，而这些片段的时长从同一分布中抽取。在有限溢出（carryover）效应的条件下，我们证明了Horvitz-Thompson估计量的均方误差具有一个简单的频域表示，该表示由时间上的结果模式与设计所导致的不平衡模式及污染模式之间的对齐方式决定。这一表示给出了一个可处理的最坏情况设计准则，可以直接从时长分布计算得出。即使仅在一个简单的双速率族上进行优化，也会产生依赖于运行时长的设计……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了随机时长切换实验的频域分析框架，证明Horvitz-Thompson估计量的均方误差具有简单的频谱表示，并由此导出一个可直接从时长分布计算的最坏情况设计准则。
